### 🚀 What's New in v2.22.34

* **Call Playback Auto-Pause & Silence Shield**: Fixed playback stutter on incoming and active phone calls by cleanly flushing audio sink buffers and preventing buffer underflow/stutter loops.
* **Smart Dynamic Home Feed & Live Shuffle**: Added dynamic YouTube Music recommendations for Quick Picks and Carousel feeds that automatically refresh and shuffle on app launch.
* **Apple-Inspired Thick Slider & iOS Headphone Icon**: Updated bottom bar device indicator with dedicated iOS headphone iconography and wired Apple-style fluid thick slider into the player.
* **In-App Updater & Previous APK Management**: Direct in-app update experience with real-time download progress bar and single-click cleanup for previously downloaded APKs in device storage.
